title: Arbiter of Ash Encounter Verification Notes
summary: A source-linked encounter verification plan for Arbiter of Ash; location, phases, attacks, and response windows remain under review.
description: A source-linked encounter verification page for Arbiter of Ash in the 0.5.4 Patch scope.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

sections.title: Scope
paragraphs: The Arbiter of Ash is a launch research candidate because current Patch notes may affect endgame encounter behaviour. This page does not preserve any prior version's phase sequence, damage assumption, or positioning advice.

sections.title: Observation plan
paragraphs: Capture the current encounter name, entry path, and character context.
Record each phase transition only when it is observed, including the visible trigger and recovery result.
Describe attacks by their telegraph and observed outcome until official or in-game naming is confirmed.
Test one response at a time, with the same build state where possible.
Mark any phase, arena, or damage conclusion under-review when a later Patch or Hotfix changes the evidence.

sections.title: What must be verified before strategy claims
paragraphs: A published guide needs the correct location, entry requirements, all observed phases, tested mitigation/positioning options, and a list of what has not been tested. It must not present a single successful attempt as a universal strategy or state unobserved loot/attack details as fact.
